title: 中欧财富MCP授权
description: 填写中欧财富 MCP API Key ，用于查询基金、高端、投顾数据。Key 仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传云端。
description_en: Enter your zocaifu MCP API Key to query fund, high-end wealth management, and advisory data. The key is stored only locally under ~/.workbuddy and is never uploaded to the cloud.

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: 粘贴 aits_ 开头的个人密钥，不要加 Bearer
fields.placeholder_en: Paste the aits_ personal key. Do not add Bearer.
fields.description: 打开开通页，手机号验证后复制个人密钥。WorkBuddy 会自动加上 Bearer 前缀。
fields.description_en: Open the signup page, verify by SMS, then copy your personal key. WorkBuddy will prefix Bearer automatically.
